create_MLIPPredictUnit: create an MLIPPredictUnit from a checkpoint file to run molecular property inference on atomic data
run_MLIPPredictUnit_predict: run predictions on AtomicData using an MLIPPredictUnit to get energy, forces, and stress outputs
create_ParallelMLIPPredictUnit: create a ParallelMLIPPredictUnit with Ray workers to distribute inference across multiple GPUs
run_ParallelMLIPPredictUnit_predict: run distributed predictions on AtomicData using a ParallelMLIPPredictUnit with multiple Ray workers
use_collate_predictions_decorator: use the collate_predictions decorator to aggregate per-system and per-atom predictions by property name
